label: Separator
when: a decorative divider line between two parts of a section (a short accent line, a row of leaves)
rules: A divider line, self-closing. Use it rarely, never as empty space. "separatorStyle": solid (the default, leave it out), dashed, dotted, double, or the patterns rectangles, parallelogram, slash, leaves. "separatorWidth", "separatorHeight" and "separatorSize" are unit STRINGS such as "80px" or "50%", never numbers. A pattern needs "separatorHeight" (about "16px") and "separatorSize", the length of one repeat ("16px"). "separatorAlign": left or right (center is the default). "separatorColor" is a palette slug.
example: Every bike gets the same careful check before it leaves the workshop.
